items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: yes I heard Kimball on bass... I saw him, you know, when I was a kid play with Bebe.

ctx.x: Well did you hear Kimball on the bass?
Kimball, yeah, sure. Henry Kimball was it? Henry Kimball, that's right, yes I heard Kimball on bass.
Do you remember where you heard him?
